rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The press-conference record 安倍内閣総理大臣記者会見 dated 24 September 2007 records Abe speaking as Prime Minister (安倍総理), apologising for the timing of his announced resignation.

locator.section: title, date line 平成１９年９月２４日, 【安倍総理冒頭発言】

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In his opening remarks (【安倍総理冒頭発言】) he says he had been in hospital receiving treatment since the 13th (１３日以降、入院して治療に専念); the attending physician speaks of 12 days in hospital.

locator.section: 【安倍総理冒頭発言】 first paragraph; answer of 慶應義塾大学病院 日比教授

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Asked about an acting Prime Minister during his hospitalisation, Abe answers that, judging under the law how far his duties were impeded, no acting Prime Minister (臨時代理) was designated this time.

locator.section: 【質疑応答】 first answer, third paragraph (また、臨時代理についてでございますが…)

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the same opening remarks (【安倍総理冒頭発言】) he says that 'tomorrow' he will leave the office of Prime Minister (明日で内閣総理大臣の職を辞することになります) and congratulates 福田康夫 on his election as party president the day before.

locator.section: 【安倍総理冒頭発言】 sixth paragraph
